concepts.title: Perpendicular Bisector Construction
concepts.definition: A line that divides a segment into two equal halves while meeting it at a right angle.
concepts.key_idea: Any point equidistant from the segment endpoints lies on the perpendicular bisector.

concepts.title: Angle Bisection
concepts.definition: Dividing an angle into two equal smaller angles using a compass and ruler.
concepts.key_idea: Constructing congruent triangles ensures the line through the vertex and arc intersection bisects the angle.

concepts.title: Angle Copying
concepts.definition: Replicating an existing angle at a different location using congruence properties.
concepts.key_idea: Constructing an identical triangle (SSS congruence) at the new vertex copies the angle.

concepts.title: Tiling Feasibility
concepts.definition: Determining if a region can be perfectly covered by specific shapes without gaps or overlaps.
concepts.key_idea: A region is tileable if its properties (like parity or color count) match the tiling unit.
